newsitem.title: USA: Tracor wins $7 mln army contract for flares.
newsitem.headline: Tracor wins $7 mln army contract for flares.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Thursday it has won a year-long, $7 million contract from the U.S. Army to produce MJU-10 infrared flares for the U.S. Air Force's F-15 aircraft.

Tracor will produce more than 140,000 flares, which will be produced in East Camden, Ark., where Tracor will hire from 30 to 40 additional people to fulfill the production requirement. Deliveries are slated through April 1998.

The company said that although it has never produced this particular flare design, it does have related experience in developing and producing flares for a range of aircraft, including the B-1 bomber.
Tracor is a defense electronics firms with 1996 annual sales of more than $1 billion.
